description: Step through a GoldCoach script. Without at: the entry of a stage (the first when stage is omitted). With at (the message you just asked) and the person's response (affirmed, corrected or rejected for a statement; yes or no; answered for a free answer): the message that follows from what they said, so two people starting the same script get different routes, each traceable to their own statements (send the statement_ids the response followed). Each step names the GoldSeam tools to call in order and the CourseShelf areas it relies on. With the session open_my_coach returned (session_id and person_handle), each step is recorded on the person's record (the script run, the stage reached, where to continue) and a milestone the step carries is recorded, not shared with the sponsor until the person shares it (coach_milestone_share). The check-in script answers the person's record first. In a trial sponsorship only the opening script and the first avenue answer. With email_my_history true, the session and the address the person typed: their GoldCoach history (sessions, scripts, stages, milestones; never the words) is emailed to them.

at.description: The message key the last step answered (step.at)

email.description: With email_my_history: the address the person typed in the chat

email_my_history.description: Email the person their GoldCoach history, on their own request

response.description: What the person said to it

script_id.description: The script, as coach_scripts lists it

session.description: The session open_my_coach returned: session_id and person_handle

stage.description: Optional: the stage to enter; the first when omitted

statement_ids.description: The person's own statements (from the Selfie) the response followed

version.description: Optional: a version; the latest when omitted
